_comment: Bandit baseline for the CI gate (.github/workflows/ci.yml). The known md5/sha1 uses (B324) below are cache keys / dedup fingerprints, not security hashes, so the gate no longer skips B324 for the whole tree. Bandit matches entries by file + test + issue text (not line), so a new weak hash in any other file still fails the gate. Drop an entry once its call passes usedforsecurity=False.
